description: This walk takes you along a section of the Stroudwater Canal from Stroud to the neighbouring village of Stonehouse. The route runs for a distance of just under 3 miles, following the flat canal towpath west from Stroud. On the way you will pass Dudbridge and Ebley before finishing in the picturesque village of Stonehouse. There's a lovely view here over the canal to the historic old church and the surrounding Cotswolds hills and countryside.
